name: Remember
why: A fact or recurring job, from the files a thread reads to project memory and a scheduled task
ideal: Rules sit where a thread reads them, memory stays short and current, and every recurring job runs as a scheduled task.

sources.title: Claude Code: how Claude remembers your project
Claude Code: automate work with scheduled tasks

steps.name: Say
steps.rule: A thread reads each rule about memory and tracking in a file it loads.

steps.name: Load
steps.rule: The largest file every session loads stays under 200 lines.

steps.name: Save
steps.rule: The memory index head stays short, so every call carries little of it.

steps.name: Clean
steps.rule: A rule, skill or agent that no recent session used is put to work or fixed, never turned off or removed.

steps.name: Schedule
steps.rule: Each recurring job is a named scheduled task with its day, not a thread kept alive.
